user.title: Connect Open WebUI Agent
user.description: Choose Open WebUI to connect directly, or AI gateway to use the home AI gateway. For the gateway, enter its URL and an API client token from the gateway admin API clients screen.

data_description.backend: AI gateway: the gateway chooses the model, tools, memory, thinking, chat history and who is speaking.
data_description.base_url: Open WebUI: its base URL. AI gateway: the gateway URL, not the Open WebUI URL.
data_description.api_key: Open WebUI: an API key. AI gateway: the token shown once when you create an API client.

agent.title: Model and agent features
agent.description: Open WebUI runs the agent and its tools. Features also require server configuration and model/user permissions. Code Interpreter requires a server engine such as Jupyter.

data.keep_chat_history: Keep chat history in Open WebUI

data_description.thinking_mode: Disabled sends reasoning_effort: none. Supported by NInfer and compatible models; providers without this setting may reject it. Model default keeps your server settings.
data_description.keep_chat_history: Off: delete chats created by this integration after 15 minutes idle. Active-session follow-ups keep their context. Saved Open WebUI Memory is separate. On: retain chats and cancel pending cleanup. Older untracked chats are untouched.
data_description.conversation_mode: Questions continues when the reply ends in a question. Say "let's talk" to keep the current session listening, or "end conversation" to stop. Always continues after every successful reply. Requires a compatible Assist satellite.

tools.title: Open WebUI tools
tools.description: Model defaults read the tools attached to your Open WebUI model. The list below is used only in Custom tool selection mode. An empty custom selection disables external tools; built-in feature settings remain independent. Complete MCP OAuth authorization in Open WebUI first.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: Optional server-side Open Terminal access. Select a terminal only for the specific-terminal mode. Your model and API user must have permission.

gateway.title: AI gateway
gateway.description: Gateway status: {status}. The gateway decides the model, tools, memory, thinking, chat history and who is speaking. These settings only change how Home Assistant waits and listens.

data_description.completion_timeout: How long Home Assistant waits for an answer. The gateway's profile can only shorten it. If it passes after the gateway accepted the request, you hear that it is still working.
data_description.conversation_mode: Questions continues when the reply ends in a question. Say "let's talk" to keep the current session listening, or "end conversation" to stop. Always continues after every successful reply. Requires a compatible Assist satellite.
data_description.strip_markdown: Clean the text shown in the Assist chat. Speech always uses the gateway's speech text.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Open WebUI. Check the URL, network and server logs.
error.invalid_auth: Open WebUI rejected the API key. Check API-key enablement and replace the key.
error.permission_denied: The Open WebUI API user lacks permission. Check user access and API endpoint restrictions.
error.not_found: The Open WebUI resource was not found. Check the server and its API version.
error.invalid_response: Open WebUI returned an unexpected response. Check version compatibility and server logs.
error.unsupported_api: The required native agent API is unavailable. Use current Open WebUI, Native function calling, and enable streaming on the model.
error.timeout: Open WebUI timed out. Increase the timeout if needed. A previously accepted action may still finish; inspect the saved chat before retrying.
error.model_missing: The saved model is unavailable. Its ID is preserved. Select an accessible model or restore its permissions in Open WebUI.
error.resource_unavailable: A selected Open WebUI tool or terminal is unavailable. Check model defaults, access, and MCP OAuth authorization in the browser.
error.agent_failed: Open WebUI did not save a completed text answer. Inspect the Home Assistant chat in Open WebUI for errors or non-text output.
error.unexecuted_tool: Open WebUI returned an unexecuted tool call. Check Native function calling, model tool support and tool assignments. The integration did not execute it.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
error.no_models: No models are visible to this API key. Check model visibility and user permissions in Open WebUI.
error.discovery_partial: Some resources are unavailable or need OAuth authorization. Saved IDs are preserved. Check permissions in Open WebUI; terminal discovery is optional when no terminal is used.
error.terminal_required: Choose an available terminal, or select None / Use model default terminal.
error.gateway_unreachable: Cannot connect to the AI gateway. Check the URL, port and network.
error.gateway_unauthorized: The AI gateway rejected the token. Create or copy a current token in the gateway admin API clients screen.
error.gateway_forbidden: The gateway token lacks permission. Check its scopes in the gateway admin.
error.not_gateway: This URL did not answer like the AI gateway. Enter the gateway URL and port, not the Open WebUI URL.
error.gateway_error: The AI gateway reported an internal error. Check the gateway logs.

abort.already_configured: An instance with this name is already configured.
